environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a custom rule group with priority 1 that inspects the Host header and Origin header on WebSocket upgrade requests (HTTP method GET with Connection: Upgrade). The rule uses a regex pattern set (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789:regional/regexpatternset/dns-rebind-detect/abc123) that matches Host headers not in the explicit allowlist (realtime.example.com, app.example.com). Additionally, the WebACL includes AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY and CrossSiteScripting_BODY in COUNT mode, and a rate-based rule limiting to 2000 requests per 5 minutes per IP. The ALB listener rule on port 443 forwards only requests with Host header matching 'realtime.example.com' to the target group; all other Host values receive a fixed 403 response. The ALB does NOT forward requests where the Host header fails to match, meaning DNS rebinding attacks that resolve an attacker domain to the ALB IP will be rejected at the ALB layer before reaching the application. Security group restricts inbound to ALB only (no direct access to Fargate tasks).

config.load_balancer: ALB with host-based routing rule: Host == realtime.example.com -> forward, else -> fixed 403
config.waf_web_acl: WebACL with custom rule group priority 1: regex match on Host/Origin headers against allowlist
config.network: Fargate tasks in private subnet, SG allows inbound only from ALB SG
config.tls: ACM certificate for realtime.example.com on ALB
